dict.string: Look up PoE2 currency exchange rates for the current league via poe2scout.com
Search a currency, or convert with e.g. "mirror in divine"

PoE2 Currency Exchange ======================
Look up Path of Exile 2 currency prices and exchange rates for the current league, powered by the public poe2scout.com API.
Usage (keyword: poe2) --------------------- poe2 divine Price of Divine Orb (shown in Exalted, plus Divine) poe2 omen Search across ALL currency types (orbs, omens, essences…) poe2 mirror in divine Mirror of Kalandra priced in Divine Orbs poe2 chaos in exalt Chaos priced in Exalted poe2 @essences greed Narrow to a single category with @category
Press Return to copy the exchange value to the clipboard. Press Cmd+Return to copy the currency name instead.
How it works ------------ All poe2scout prices are denominated in the league base currency (Exalted Orb), so the rate between any two items A and B is simply price(A) / price(B). The full currency list is fetched once and cached for a few minutes, so typing stays instant. The current league is detected automatically.
Configuration (Workflow Environment Variables) ---------------------------------------------- REALM Game realm path segment (default: auto-detect "poe2") LEAGUE Force a specific league name (default: auto-detect current) CATEGORY Restrict search to one category (default: all currency categories) API_BASE API base URL (default: https://poe2scout.com/api) CACHE_TTL Seconds to cache price data (default: 600) USER_AGENT Custom User-Agent for API requests
Requires python3 (ships with macOS Command Line Tools). Data: https://poe2scout.com • API: https://poe2scout.com/api/swagger
